go_cache_path: $XDG_CACHE_HOME/symaira/updatecheck/<sha256(owner NUL repo)>.json, falling back to $HOME/.cache when XDG_CACHE_HOME is not absolute
cache_disable: set Checker.CachePath to an empty string
force_behavior: bypass both in-memory and persistent cache layers
v0_major_gap_rule: when current.major == 0 and latest.major > 0, no update is offered
opt_out_note: corekit's Checker does not read the opt-out itself; each consumer is responsible for skipping the Check call when the env var or config key is set.
